blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: switch — Forwards frames inside local network.
router — Forwards packets between IP networks.
access point — Provides wireless connection to LAN.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: A LAN covers a local area such as a school building; a WAN connects networks across wider geography.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Client-server uses dedicated service systems; peer-to-peer allows peers to exchange roles and resources, with different management implications.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: NICs connect devices, switches forward local Ethernet frames, wireless APs bridge Wi-Fi, and routers forward IP packets between networks.

blocks.title: Worked example · Check the answer
blocks.text: router handles packets destined for another network.
